title: How Smoking vs Vaping Affects Your Lungs  ● You Must See This ! !
summary: A demonstration comparing what a month of vaping versus a month of smoking cigarettes does to the lungs, using a filter to show the residue. It is part of a series of similar experiments.
why: HN commenters send it to people who think vaping is as harmful as smoking, for its graphic comparison.

quote.text: Anyone who tries to tell me vaping might be worse I send them to this YouTube video
